subject: POC timeline & next steps - Zenotech
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@zenotech.com>, Lina Fernandez <lina.fernandez@zenotech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC timeline & next steps - Zenotech

Hi Samir / Lina,

Great to meet you both this morning — thanks for the thoughtful discussion about your current inference needs. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can align on a short POC that proves value for Zenotech.

High-level objective
- Validate Redwood Inference as the production runtime for your customer-facing generative search use case (60M monthly queries, 1-2 sec SLA target for search responses).

Success criteria (your asks + our measurement)
- Latency: 95th percentile under 1.5s for the mapped query set (baseline vs post-integration).
- Cost: demonstrate at least 30% cost reduction per 1M tokens vs your current setup (we'll model with same traffic profile).
- Quality: show parity or improvement on your internal relevance metric (precision@5) on a 200-query test suite.
- Stability: zero critical production errors during the 4-week evaluation window; maintain availability per the integration checklist.

Proposed evaluation plan & responsibilities
- Redwood: provide a dedicated trial pool, pre-configured model variant, and a Solutions Engineer (Neha) to help with integration and KV cache tuning.
- Zenotech: provide access to a representative dataset (sample CSV or S3), a technical point of contact (Lina), and procurement/legal contact for the SOW.

Timeline (suggested)
- Nov 17 (Tue) — POC kickoff (30-60m): confirm access, runbook, and success criteria.
- Week of Nov 17 — Integration & baseline runs (Redwood + Zenotech).
- Week of Nov 24 — Quantitative tests (latency/cost/quality), tuning pass.
- Dec 8 — Final readout prep & draft recommendations.
- Dec 15 — Final readout + decision meeting.

Weekly check-ins: Fridays, 30 minutes (status, blockers, next actions).

Attachments: I attached a draft POC SOW (POC_SOW_v1.pdf) and a short roll-forward plan. I'll also link the HubSpot deal for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/zenotech/12345.

Next actions for this week
1) Can you confirm stakeholders (owner + technical contact) and whether Nov 17 works for kickoff?
2) Please confirm where we should upload sample data and any internal procurement steps we should be aware of.
3) If procurement wants an SOW/PO template, please loop them in (cc'd address is fine).

Happy to hop back on a quick call if you'd like to walk the timeline.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: POC timeline & next steps - Zenotech

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Nov 17 works for the kickoff on our side (tentatively — I need to confirm with one more stakeholder).

A few notes/questions from the tech/procurement side:
- Lina will be the engineering lead for the integration (she's copied).
- We will need a short data handling summary for our security team — can you confirm data retention, logging, and whether the trial uses any shared staging clusters?
- Procurement asked for any standard PO requirements and a sample invoice layout so they can pre-clear payment terms. I've attached a doc with our procurement checklist (zenotech_po_requirements.docx).

If you can share the SOC2 report and any MSA/SOW templates we can get procurement started, that'd speed things up. We are committed to the timeline if procurement/legal doesn't have major edits.

Cheers,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Product Partnerships | Zenotech
samir.gupta@zenotech.com

Hi Samir / Lina — thanks, and great to have Lina join the thread. I've looped Rachel (AE) to keep commercial coordination aligned.

Quick answers and a slightly more detailed milestone plan below.

Data handling & security (summary) - Trial environment: your trial will run on a dedicated Redwood trial pool per the SOW — no shared customer data planes.
- Retention: logs and metrics retained 30 days by default for the POC; if you need longer retention for analysis we can configure as an add-on (note implications for cost).
- Access: only named Redwoods (Neha + Marissa) and your named Zenotech contacts will have access to the trial project during the POC.
- SOC2 & evidence: here's our SOC2 summary and report link: https://redwoodinference.com/security/soc2-report.pdf.

Updated milestone schedule (dates are target — we can pick exact times on kickoff):
- Nov 17 (Tue) — POC kickoff (30-45m): confirm creds, upload path for sample data, success criteria checklist. Owner: Marissa (Redwood) + Samir (Zenotech).
- Nov 18-24 — Integration & baseline runs: Neha will support SDK/instrumentation and KV-cache config; Lina to validate data mappings.
- Nov 25 - Dec 1 — Tuning & cost modeling: run at expected traffic profile and compare token economics.
- Dec 2 - Dec 8 — Final validation & readout prep.
- Dec 15 — Final readout & decision meeting (1 hour): show results vs success criteria; recommended next steps.

Weekly checkpoints: Fridays at 10am PT (first check-in 2026-11-20). I'll send calendar invites once we confirm stakeholders.

Mutual action plan (owners / next steps)
- Redwood: deliver trial cluster + pre-configured model, run baseline tests (owner: Neha).
- Zenotech: provide sample data + run the internal QA tests (owner: Lina).
- Commercial: Rachel to coordinate SOW signature and procurement items (owner: Rachel).

Next steps for you this week
1) Confirm kickoff time on Nov 17 and primary stakeholders.
2) Procurement: if you can share a preferred PO/invoice template, Rachel will align the SOW/payment terms to that.
3) Once procurement confirms, we'll send the DocuSign SOW link.

I've attached the POC SOW draft again for review. If you prefer, I can schedule a 15-minute slot for procurement + Rachel to go through the commercial bits.

Best,
Marissa
